text: Appeal of Property Standards Order (May 5, 2025) for 2495 Dufferin Street

The Property Standards Committee – North York Panel: 1. Confirmed the Property Standards Order (May 5, 2025) for 2495 Dufferin Street, Folder Number 25 153063 PRS 00 IV, and in so doing granted an extension to September 9, 2025 to complete the work to the satisfaction of the City.
